decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot absorbs the learning from the withdrawn standalone shuttering robot and draws directly on in-house formwork, automation and control expertise, so the firm can refine it through its own R&D.

The automatic de-shuttering robot stays closely tied to the firm's precast plant knowledge, but since Product D was dropped the combined robot may cannibalise it, which raises the risk somewhat while early feedback is still useful.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots and builds on the firm's material-handling and control capabilities, giving it integration value within automated circulation lines.
The newly launched multi-model magazining, cleaning and plotting line extends core pallet-preparation know-how, and the firm's R&D lets it interpret early results and adapt the models.
The production analysis software builds on the firm's in-house control and planning expertise, generates data that strengthens the firm's absorptive capacity, and costs little to maintain.
